4506-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
4506-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

3629-6731-8089.easyPrerequisites:
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
Your life total is even.
3629-6731-8089.description:
Activate Deepwood Ghoul by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

997-2073-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

215-539-5614-7781.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-539-5614-7781.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Bighorner Rancher
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1322-2440-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4947-5078-6766-7175.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

628-6798-7188.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

4365-4659-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4365-4659-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

911-2034-6972--112.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
911-2034-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

328-5220-6797-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-5220-6797-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

338-567-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-567-4186.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2645-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues.
2645-3918-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3918-5527.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

1418-2608-4605.notablePrerequisites: You control up to six permanents that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
1418-2608-4605.description:
Activate up to six permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger twice.
Resolve both Derevi triggers, untapping up to two permanents.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Derevi that is a 0/1 Illusion creature token.
Put the nontoken Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and choose to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping up to two permanents.
Resolve the second Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Derevi that is a 0/1 Illusion creature token.
Put either Derevi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping up to two permanents.
Activate up to six permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put the remaining Derevi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2921-4558-5913.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-2921-4558-5913.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk.
Repeat.

2707-4377-5373.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Kylox's Voltstrider
2707-4377-5373.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Kylox's Voltstrider's first ability by exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard, causing Kylox's Voltstrider to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Kylov's Voltstrider as an attacker.
Kylox's Voltstrider triggers, causing you to pay {4}{U}{U} to cast Walk the Aeons from exile.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat.

Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.

Urabrask triggers, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve Demonic Gifts.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cormela enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.

When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2762-4434-4762-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Thopter Squadron has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
"Treefolk" chosen with Conspiracy.
2762-4434-4762-4875.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield as a Treefolk due to Conspiracy, Quickbeam triggers, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

2493-2792-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.

Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Great Whale.
When Great Whale and Archaeomancer enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Displace to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1978-3660-4893.notablePrerequisites: Millikin does not have summoning sickness.
1978-3660-4893.description:
Activate Millkin by tapping it and milling a card, adding {C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Millikin.
Repeat.

1409-2366-2499-2653.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Nissa twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{U}.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Dryad Arbor.
Repeat.

527-1752-4116.notablePrerequisites:
Locust Swarm and Marwyn have at least one counter on them.
Volrath does not have summoning sickness.
527-1752-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Locust Swarm until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {G}, untapping it.
Repeat.

88-779-2894-4126.description:
Attempt to draw a card.
The card draw is replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, causing you instead to discard Dakmor Salvage, then mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
